language.title: Jobs
language.description: The Quartz Job Scheduler is a powerful, open-source scheduler for scheduling, managing, and executing jobs in a scalable and flexible environment. This page shows you all the jobs running and allows to manage them.
language.custom: You can create here a new job by defining the necessary json struct or simply click on edit on a listed job above to edit it.

Import jobs from the classic Scheduled Tasks to the new Quartz Scheduler. This migration tool converts your existing scheduled tasks to Quartz jobs with equivalent functionality. Multiple imports are safe - existing jobs with the same URL will be updated rather than duplicated.
Delete original tasks from Scheduled Tasks after successful import. WARNING: This action cannot be undone.
Import Jobs (Tasks) from the classic Schdeuled Tasks application. You can do multiple imports, if the a job already exists with the same endpoint (URL) it will be simply updated.
When checked the tasks get deleted from the scheduled tasks application after a sucessful import into Quartz scheduler, this step cannot be undone.
You can create here a new job by defining the necessary json struct.
Insert a pre-configured job template into the textarea above
Call URL every 5 seconds on working hours
call URL once a month on the 14th when a weekday
call URL once on specific date
